en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a semi‑nude woman reclining on cushions and textiles in an orientalist 'harem' or 'odalisque' pose. She wears a headscarf with a gold forehead ornament, a necklace and bracelet, and loose draped trousers or skirt. The background shows embroidered or woven decorative fabrics. In the upper right is printed text in French with a catalog number.
